Give the badge a short text label and choose a variant for its visual emphasis.

## Usage

```ts
import { badge, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/badge';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/badge`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-badge"></a>

Slots `default`.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Badge>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.BadgeVariant`.

- `components.badgeVariants` takes options `variant` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
